Method notes

  • CKAN package 5423054a-093c-4239-85be-fa0b36ae0b2e is excluded because it is AIA documentation rather than an AIA analysis.
  • AIAs without usable JSON are retained and score 0% completeness.
  • Impact level is derived only for successfully parsed JSON-backed AIAs.
  • Peer-review coverage is checked only for impact level 2+ AIAs and requires a separately published CKAN resource whose title, description, or URL explicitly identifies it as a peer review. A peer-review mention in the package description alone does not count.
  • Project Phase is read from projectDetailsPhase and decoded with the questionnaire definition matching each AIA version.
  • Selected data-quality and consultation answers use the Design or Implementation fields matching each AIA's saved Project Phase. The GBA Plus public-information field resolves to question 6 for v0.x and question 7 for v1.x. Answer codes are decoded with the matching questionnaire. Conditional public-availability follow-ups are applicable when their first question is Yes, or when an explicit follow-up answer is saved.
  • Non-conditional completeness excludes questions with their own visibleIf and questions nested under conditional containers.
  • Completeness measures structural population of questionnaire fields, not accuracy, quality, validity, or policy compliance.

The notebook that generated this report requires no stored analytical input files. It begins with the public Open Government Portal CKAN API, then downloads the current published JSON resources and AIA questionnaire schemas.
